verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud and ML platform that hosts user data and models. Whether customer data is excluded from AI training is therefore a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has no data-use policy, training opt-out, or privacy commitment on the subject, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
